name: changers
description: Changemakers — the network for young people who make change happen. Next.js frontend (apps/web) on a PostgREST-compatible API (apps/api) over Postgres with row-level security.

scripts.dev: npm run dev --workspace @changers/api & npm run dev --workspace changemakers-site
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @changers/api && npm run build --workspace changemakers-site
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @changers/api && npm run typecheck --workspace changemakers-site
